description: How can enterprises adopt AI and agentic systems while keeping people, business value, and trust at the center? Chris is joined by Dr. Gautham Pallapa, Principal Director of AI and Innovation at Scotiabank and author of Invaluable, to explore how organizations can approach AI-driven transformation. They discuss identifying meaningful opportunities for AI in highly regulated industries like banking, rethinking developer productivity, and using multi-agent systems to bring different roles and capabilities together.
